appid.description: Steam App ID of the game (Project Zomboid is '108600').

publishedfileid.description: Workshop item ID. Set to '0' for the first upload. SteamCMD writes the new ID back into the file after a successful upload.

contentfolder.description: Absolute path to the folder containing the mod content (use double backslashes '\\' on Windows).

previewfile.description: Absolute path to the preview image (preview.gif or preview.png, must be < 1MB).

title.description: Public display name of the mod on Steam Workshop. ASCII only, max 128 bytes.

changenote.description: Note describing changes in this update (e.g., 'First release').

visibility.description: Visibility of the mod: '0' = Public, '1' = Friends Only, '2' = Private, '3' = Unlisted.
